leadText: Evelyn Lanto is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .
plainText:
Evelyn Lanto is an American voice actress for the English-language dub of .

==Biography==
Lanto was born as Carrie Keranen on January 16, 1987. She first joined the in the seventh season of , providing additional voices until and TAJ Productions took over the dubbing and distribution of the series. She later returned in the episode Hot Springing a Leak!. She is credited under the names of Caroline Hellman in the seventh season, Caroline Lawson in the episode The Evolutionary War, and Evelyn Lanto from Absol-ute Disaster onwards. Lanto is currently affiliated with AVO Talent Agency.
